designacao: Guitarra de Coimbra de João Palmeiro, Montijo, 1994, feita para Ron Fernandez

fontes.citacao: This guitarra was made for me by Joao Palmeiro
Below: João Palmeiro Coimbra style Guitarra. Made in Montijo, across from Lisboa. 1994.

factos.valor: Tampo de abeto (spruce), escala de pau-santo (rosewood), fundo provavelmente de sicómoro (sycamore); escala de 470 mm

fontes.citacao: The face is spruce, the fingerboard is rosewood, the back is probably sycamore. 470mm scale.

factos.valor: Acabamento final a goma-laca (French polish), trastos e afinação por Ron Fernandez

fontes.citacao: I did the final French Polished finish, refined the frets and set-up the instrument.
The entire instrument was French Polished by Ron Fernandez.
